graphs-data-skill-01.target: I can read a picture graph where each picture stands for 1 and tell how many are in each category.
graphs-data-skill-01.ifCorrect: You can do this: can read a picture graph where each picture stands for 1 and tell how many are in each category.
graphs-data-skill-01.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Counting pictures in the wrong row, or adding all rows when asked about one. Try this: Point to each picture as you count and read the label at the start of the row.

graphs-data-skill-02.target: I can read a bar graph with a scale of 1 and tell how many are in each category.
graphs-data-skill-02.ifCorrect: You can do this: can read a bar graph with a scale of 1 and tell how many are in each category.
graphs-data-skill-02.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Counting the grid lines instead of reading the number where the bar ends, or starting at 1. Try this: Slide a finger from the top of the bar straight across to the scale and read the number.

graphs-data-skill-03.target: I can use a picture graph or bar graph to solve put-together, take-apart, and compare problems.
graphs-data-skill-03.ifCorrect: You can do this: can use a picture graph or bar graph to solve put-together, take-apart, and compare problems.
graphs-data-skill-03.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Adding when the question asks how many more, or comparing the wrong categories. Try this: Write the two numbers you need from the graph first, then decide whether to add or subtract.

graphs-data-skill-04.skill: Making Picture Graphs and Bar Graphs
graphs-data-skill-04.target: I can make a picture graph or bar graph from a tally chart or table with up to four categories.
graphs-data-skill-04.ifCorrect: You can do this: can make a picture graph or bar graph from a tally chart or table with up to four categories.
graphs-data-skill-04.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Making bars or rows that do not match the data, or forgetting a title, labels, or a key. Try this: Check each bar against the tally chart, then add the title and labels.
